name: Fox Tab Groups
description: Auto-group tabs with custom rules, save and restore tab groups as snapshots, and manage open groups with shortcuts.

_execute_action.description: Open the Fox Tab Groups popup

group-tabs.description: Group the selected tab(s): add them to the current tab's group, or create a new group

ungroup-tabs.description: Remove the selected tab(s) from their group

toggle-collapse-group.description: Collapse or expand the current tab's group

auto-group-by-domain.description: Auto-group all tabs in this window by domain

apply-rules.description: Apply grouping rules to all tabs in this window

new-tab-in-group.description: Open a new tab inside the current tab's group

move-group-to-new-window.description: Move the current tab's group to a new window

collapse-all-groups.description: Collapse every group in this window

expand-all-groups.description: Expand every group in this window

toggle-pin-tab.description: Pin or unpin the current tab

duplicate-tab.description: Duplicate the current tab (stays in the same group)

save-window-snapshot.description: Save a snapshot of all tabs and groups in this window

activate-next-group.description: Jump to the next tab group

activate-previous-group.description: Jump to the previous tab group
